scope: Read-only triage of scan-v2 cix-native-core while the active scan is preserved. It recommends later bounded CIX-owned work; no scanned source, vendor source, analyzer configuration, or compile database was changed.

first_party_bridge_and_ffi.disposition: CIX-owned candidates for later, focused work. Most findings are maintainability policy violations; they are not evidence of a presently failing codec operation.

external_headers.disposition: Report separately; do not edit vendored or SDK headers.

analyzer_configuration_artifacts.detail: 100 missing system includes, one missing project include in the example translation unit, and one checkers-report metadata entry. The core scan ran in a readonly overlay and did not receive a complete system/project include model.
analyzer_configuration_artifacts.disposition: No source fix. A later scanner-only follow-up may use recorded SDK/include roots and preserve the active scan evidence. kernel_overlay confirmed it will make no include rewrite or compile-database change during this scan.

correctness_triage.finding: The CharLS path forms a uint32_t stride as w * 2 for samples above eight bits. bytes() validates total size in size_t but does not establish w <= UINT32_MAX / 2. A public C ABI caller with an extreme width can wrap the stride before it reaches CharLS.
correctness_triage.bounded_fix_group: Add one precondition before each 16-bit CharLS stride construction (or centralize a checked stride helper); return CIX_SPATIAL_INVALID_ARGUMENT on overflow. Cover the rejected-width boundary and normal 8/16-bit behavior in the existing spatial contract suite.
correctness_triage.confidence: source-review candidate; not emitted by the current analyzer

correctness_triage.finding: Cppcheck reports redundantAssignment for the JP2 box walker. The assignment advances the loop cursor after payload parsing, so the warning is plausibly a path-insensitive false positive. It should not be deleted without a focused malformed-JP2 regression check.
correctness_triage.bounded_fix_group: No source change from this scan alone. Re-evaluate after include-model cleanup or with a narrowly targeted parser test.

correctness_triage.finding: JXL decode/encode, spatial marker parsing and ZPAQ decode contain the high-complexity boundaries that enforce exact consumption, dimensions, output limits and cancellation. Refactoring them wholesale solely for threshold compliance risks decoder semantics.
correctness_triage.bounded_fix_group: Extract only side-effect-free checked helpers around existing branch groups, with exact-decoding and malformed-input regressions run per helper. Keep ABI function names and vendor sources unchanged.

deprioritized_first_party_findings.disposition: Bundle after correctness guards, preserving exported C ABI names and C-compatible struct names. Parser recovery in C ABI headers should be reconsidered only after the analyzer has a proper language/include configuration.

non_claim: This triage does not treat an analyzer severity as a demonstrated defect, does not modify vendor code, and does not assert a clean rescan.
